paragraphs.source_en:
(page 17 5)
Years ago I wmte three stories in which occur the names of Michael Robartes
and Owen Aherne. I now consider that I used the actual names of two friends,
and that one of these friends, Michael Robartes, has but lately returned from
Mesopotamia, where he has partly found and partly thought out much philos-
ophy." I consider that Aherne and Robartes, men to whose namesakes I had
attributed a turbulent life or death, have quarrelled with me. They take their
place in a phantasmagoria in which I endeavour to explain my philosophy
of life and death. To some extent I wrote these poems as a text for
exposition.- 1922.
